title: Hosea Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on Hosea 3: the command to love an adulteress, the price paid for her, and the many days Israel would live without king or sacrifice.

questions.text: What was the speaker told to do at the start of this chapter?
questions.explanation: Yahweh told him to go again and love a woman loved by another, an adulteress, even as Yahweh loves the children of Israel.

answers.text: To leave his wife and live alone
To go again and love a woman loved by another
To go to the king and accuse the priests
To take a wife from the house of Judah

questions.text: What does the first verse say the children of Israel love, besides turning to other gods?
questions.explanation: The verse says that though they turn to other gods, they love cakes of raisins.

answers.text: Jars of new wine
Bread of mourners
Oil and fine flour
Cakes of raisins

questions.text: For how much silver did he buy her for himself?
questions.explanation: The verse says he bought her for himself for fifteen pieces of silver, along with barley.

answers.text: Fifteen pieces of silver
Thirty pieces of silver
Fifty pieces of silver
Five pieces of silver

questions.text: What did he give besides the silver?
questions.explanation: The verse says he gave a homer and a half of barley along with the fifteen pieces of silver.

answers.text: A pair of young doves
A measure of fine wheat flour
A homer and a half of barley
A skin of new wine

questions.text: How long did he tell her she would stay with him?
questions.explanation: He said to her that she would stay with him many days.

answers.text: Seven days
Many days
Until the harvest
Three years

questions.text: What did he tell her she must not do?
questions.explanation: He told her she must not play the prostitute and must not be with any other man.

answers.text: Leave the house or go to the field
Eat bread or drink wine with strangers
Burn incense or pour out offerings
Play the prostitute or be with any other man

questions.text: What did he say about himself after telling her how she must live?
questions.explanation: He added that he would also be so toward her.

answers.text: That he would also be so toward her
That he would go away for many days
That he would pay the price again
That he would say nothing more to her

questions.text: What does this chapter say the children of Israel will live without for many days?
questions.explanation: The verse says they will live many days without king, without prince, without sacrifice, without sacred stone, and without ephod or idols.

answers.text: Without bread, water, wool, flax, oil or drink
Without feasts, new moons, Sabbaths or assemblies
Without king, prince, sacrifice, sacred stone, ephod or idols
Without walls, gates, towers or fortresses

questions.text: Whom will the children of Israel seek afterward?
questions.explanation: The verse says that afterward the children of Israel will return and seek Yahweh their God, and David their king.

answers.text: The prophets and the priests of the land
Yahweh their God, and David their king
The gods of the nations around them
A head appointed from among themselves

questions.text: How does the last verse say they will come to Yahweh and to his blessings?
questions.explanation: The verse says they will come with trembling to Yahweh and to his blessings in the last days.

answers.text: With singing
With burnt offerings
With gifts of silver
With trembling
